host_injection_at_serve_time: Files are byte-faithful to the origin as archived. Served from Cloudflare Pages, every HTML page gains ONE injected script: https://static.cloudflareinsights.com/beacon.min.js (Cloudflare Web Analytics, enabled on the zone). The zone's email obfuscation also rewrites mailto: links into /cdn-cgi/l/email-protection. Measured over the wire on 2026-10-21; the archived bytes are unaffected.
